short_description: Design and generate structured music with SandBase.
description: Craft production-ready prompts, generate approved music, and assemble longer pieces with dynamically selected SandBase music models.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for music generation
Local audio tooling for multi-clip assembly

install.prompt: Use $music-prompter to design and generate this music with SandBase.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill music-prompter --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill music-prompter --agent codex --global

examples: Write a 60-second instrumental prompt for a calm product demo.
Generate a bilingual pop song after showing me the model and price.
Plan and assemble a five-minute cinematic score from consistent clips.

optional_inputs: instrumental or vocal mode and lyrics
output format and audio quality requirements

notes: Prompt-only work does not require SandBase or incur a generation charge.
Discover and inspect live models instead of hard-coding a provider, duration limit, or schema.
Show current pricing and obtain confirmation before the first paid generation call.
Do not duplicate a pending asynchronous run.

endpoints.summary: Inspect live music schemas, limits, formats, pricing, and execution requirements.
Recover recent run status and recorded cost.
Check balance before a multi-call music batch.
